precepts.text: Whoever leaves house or family for the gospel receives a hundredfold now with persecutions, and in the world to come eternal life.
precepts.point: Our eyes have been enlightened to why these things happen. George Floyd and Breonna Taylor got the most news for 2020, but many of our people have suffered getting beat and murdered, like the brother they found in the cornfield.

note.label: Psalm 55: Cast Thy Burden Upon the Lord

precepts.why:
David would hasten his escape from the windy storm and tempest. Christ says what comes to the one who stays in the faith: “There is no man that hath left house, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my sake, and the gospel’s, But he shall receive an hundredfold now in this time, houses, and brethren, and sisters, and mothers, and children, and lands, with persecutions; and in the world to come eternal life.”

A hundredfold now, with persecutions, and in the world to come eternal life. The persecutions come with it; we must through much tribulation enter the kingdom, and we serve out this punishment rather than fly away. But the rest David wished for is promised at the end of it.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 11 A Time Of Defamation

precepts.why:
We are servants; God's son Jesus was a servant, and if we are following Christ that makes us servants. Some of you think you are almighty; no, brother, you are here to serve, that is your job. Put it perfectly: the deacon is here to make the bishop look good, the captain is here to make the deacons look good, the officers are here to make the captains look good, and so on. That is called unity, that is called leadership, that is called government.

“And whosoever of you will be the chiefest, shall be servant of all.” Everybody wants to be the chief, nobody wants to be the Indian; everybody wants to be chief but nobody wants to serve. I want the title, but I don't want to live up to the title; I just want to tell men what to do. Brothers, as leaders, if you are not ready to pick up the mop and mop the floor, you should not expect another brother to do it either, because it starts with you. A great leader raises men to be better leaders than himself; do not try to keep the brother down; you are supposed to build that brother up to be better than you; if that brother is not better than you, something is wrong.

A brother said this officer teaches better than this captain, this captain teaches better than the bishop, than the deacon. You are crazy. In Esau's world every one of us went to school to learn from a teacher, a professor. You woke up one day and said I'm better than this professor? You can go on YouTube right now and learn how to do surgery, but you are not going to let me perform on you; the first thing you'll say is, Deacon, what is your qualification, what school did you go to? Take some common sense. If you say the deacon is a good teacher, guess what: the Bishop is better. If my captains are good teachers, I am better than them; if the officers teach better than the captain, no, the captain is better, because they are learning from the higher rank. You think Peter was greater than Christ? You're an idiot. Those are common sense. That is when men start thinking they are beyond themselves: look how I teach. One brother who left said you don't have to watch Deacon so-and-so any more, which one do you want to watch, myself? Where is he at today? Those are foolish thoughts of men who are over themselves, not humbling. This mission is all about humbling, and exalting one another in due time. All those young men remember a few precepts and know how to put them together so the words sound sweet to you, but they don't know what the spirit world requires: the spirit world hates pride; pride and disrespect are not accepted in the spiritual world. Paul said these things are earthly, an earthly doctrine.

And the sister who just came in a year ago and married an officer says I'm an officer's wife and eats before the sister that has been labouring for three, four, five years. Does that make sense? The sister that married the officer of ten is no leader of nothing, but she exalts her power against a sister that lined up for years. What scripture is that? The scripture says let the young women learn from the sisters that were there before them. Hell no; you are not going to pass that. Some congregations say nothing to it: the officer of ten's wife eats and the little sister who has been labouring for years sits in the back. That can hurt somebody's spirit. Everybody has to deserve their name; get your own name, build your own legacy, put your own bricks in; don't ride on my name. Brothers who are leaders: when your wife tries to use your authority to abuse other sisters, hell no, it is not going down like that. Show some respect and honour to those who were there before you. It doesn't matter if she is Deacon so-and-so's wife; she cannot abuse or disrespect you. We are trying to escape looking down upon each other; that is why we are in this captivity in the first place, because we decided not to obey these laws and to live like savages. If you are returning to the Lord you better understand what savage is, what disrespect is, what pride is. We are here to guide you the right way as long as you believe what God said; but you have to be willing to listen and apply it, not only learn precepts.

points: But Jesus called them to him, and saith unto them, Ye know that they which are accounted to rule over the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and their great ones exercise authority upon them. So in the world, the white man, they exercise lordship over the people under them. It is terrible.

note.label: Unity: The Sweet Savor Of Salvation

points: But whosoever will be great among you, shall be your minister. That is the position we all should aspire to be in: a minister. You want to teach class, but you do not think about the hours it takes to get in to teach the class. You want to be the bishop, but you do not think about the thirty years, the thirty-eight years of education, of reading books and travelling the world and dealing with councils and matters, so you can have that experience to teach your people. You just see the glitz and glamour. And how long he sat under men listening, for years.

note.label: Unity: The Sweet Savor Of Salvation

points: And when he was gone forth into the way, there came one running, and kneeled to him, and asked him, Good Master, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life? What shall I do that I may get the kingdom?

note.label: The Exponential Maturation In The Days Of Decadence

points: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is, God. Thou knowest the commandments. So he was actually speaking to a brother that knew the Bible. He says, you already know the commandments. Listen to this here, because in another part of the scriptures he was raised up to keep the commandments and all that, and he said he lacked nothing. That is in Matthew. I think it is Mark and Matthew that wrote about the same thing.

note.label: The Exponential Maturation In The Days Of Decadence

points: Do not commit adultery. So that is a commandment we have to do. Do not kill. And another part of the Bible says, Do no murder. Do not steal. Do not bear false witness. So while we are in this captivity we are not supposed to be doing these things. We are not supposed to be stealing. We are not supposed to be committing adultery. We are not supposed to be murdering, false witnesses, none of that. We are supposed to learn how to operate as a righteous people in this captivity. You all understand what I am saying?
Defraud not. Do not lie to each other. Honour thy father and mother.
